title: Alien and Cats at Cosmic Portal
description: A green alien stands on a rocky cliff edge, waving toward a swirling cosmic vortex that contains a large cracked moon with a serene sleeping face. Three cats sit beside the alien looking at the portal: a gray cat, a black cat, and an orange tabby wearing a blue scarf.
prompt: A green alien standing on a rocky cliff waving at a massive swirling cosmic portal made of purple and blue patterned rings containing a giant cracked moon with a peaceful sleeping face. Three cats sit beside the alien: gray, black, and orange tabby with a scarf. Stars, lightning, galaxy swirls, tree roots hanging from above, scattered pottery and a green skull on the ground, surreal visionary style, vibrant cosmic colors.
